title: Aromatic Savory Spanish Vegetable Cocido Madrileno
description: This savory Spanish dish features a rich vegetable stock and is low in fat, making it a comforting and healthy option. It is traditionally cooked in a binchotan grill vessel.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill vessel to medium heat.
In a large bowl, knead together the chopped onions, minced garlic, and smoked paprika for about 5 minutes until well combined.
Add the chopped carrots, cubed potatoes, and shredded cabbage to the bowl and knead for another 5 minutes until the vegetables are well coated with the onion mixture.
Heat the olive oil in the preheated binchotan grill vessel and add the kneaded vegetable mixture.
Pour in the low sodium vegetable stock and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the cocido for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Season the cocido with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the cocido hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
